## Diagnosis

**Root cause:** `SyntaxError: invalid character '×' (U+00D7)` — the module docstring at the top of `solution.py` contains a Unicode multiplication sign (`×`, e.g. in `coupon×*`). Python source files must be valid UTF-8 but the tokenizer rejects `×` outside of strings/comments-as-string context; here it landed in a docstring body in a way that the assembler emitted it outside the string literal boundary, or the em-dash/`×` combination broke the header. In any case the fix is identical: **replace every non-ASCII glyph in the header with its ASCII equivalent** (`×` → `x`). Nothing else in the logic is affected — the LightGBM/FT blend changes are fine.

The minimal, targeted fix below rewrites the offending header line with ASCII only. No change to task semantics, metric, splits, model, or output format.

<<<<<<< SEARCH
Categorical columns (coupon, occupation, maritalStatus, coupon×* interactions,
gender) are passed to LightGBM as native categorical features with missing
values shifted to a non-negative code.
=======
Categorical columns (coupon, occupation, maritalStatus, coupon x * interactions,
gender) are passed to LightGBM as native categorical features with missing
values shifted to a non-negative code.
>>>>>>> REPLACE
